paper_title: Strong constraints on decay and annihilation of dark matter from heating of gas-rich dwarf galaxies
notes: ALP DM bound from gas heating of Leo T dwarf galaxy (Fig. 4). The paper's primary model-independent results are on DM decay lifetime, but it recasts to ALP-photon coupling g_agamma vs ma. The paper states Leo T provides the best limit on ALP-photon coupling for ma ~ 30 eV-keV, reaching roughly g_agamma ~ few e-13 GeV^-1 near the minimum. Data points are approximate readings from Fig. 4 axis (5-1000 eV mass range); precise values were not tabulated in text. Not a haloscope so no DM density flag. Multiple couplings/models discussed (also higgs-portal scalar theta, sterile neutrino theta^2, dark neutron theta) hence moderate confidence in which coupling to extract; chose AxionPhoton (Fig 4) as the standard-coupling result. | [TEXT-VISION DISAGREEMENT] vision trace differs from the in-range text anchor by 2.8 dex (> 2.0) over the shared mass range — likely wrong curve; deferred to text | selector: text (sole candidate)
